subject: Weird - but perhaps an IE8-issue...

body:

subject: It's not as complicated as it sounds.
author: Khanon
body:
hehe I could make an SWF (flash movie) of how to do it, if you'd like. The CG guys said you could simply enable scripts to alter the status bar... There's a reason that's turned off by default...it's a security hole in your browser that allows scripts to alter your bars, helping to mask forgery sites. You don't want to do that if you can avoid it.

Let me know if you'd like me to SWF it...I have my own flash creator (I make tutorials in Flash for my workplace all the time...).

 

No more games, no more teasing. Time to play...time to die. --Pinhead
